review.identity: Canonical fairy-pitta v001 retained: chestnut crown/stripe, cream eyebrow and charcoal mask, simple brown dot eye, green/blue wing, red belly and pink feet.
review.style: Warm brown contours and watercolor/paper texture matched own canonical, no uniform repainting or vector substitution.
review.alpha: RGBA originals preserved; all9 cells in all3 current sheets pass alpha>=8 positive margin>=2px, with real transparent gutters. Rejected hedgehog haze/stray-alpha sheets retained in candidates.
review.motion: All27 named distinct key poses reviewed, including reaction states, four wave stages, planted/air/landing, clap pair, sitting and rise intermediates, seated stretch half/full, nap and gaze. GIFs remain discrete key-pose previews; smooth episode motion not certified.
